AP-1 Cellular Memory: Kinase Analysis

Reproducible analysis of persistent kinase expression and interference responses

1 Overview

This report documents a reproducible computational analysis of kinase expression associated with cellular memory in the AP-1 cellular adaptation model.

The analysis is based on the study:

Li J, Ravindran PT, O’Farrell A, et al.
AP-1 mediates cellular adaptation and memory formation.
Nature Communications 17, 4265 (2026).

The goal of this downstream analysis is to identify kinase genes associated with the post-dexamethasone memory state and examine how those kinase responses behave under AP-1-related interference conditions.

2 Reproducible workflow

The complete workflow is executed with:

Rscript run_all.R

The main analysis pipeline is:

00_fetch_data.R
        ↓
01_setup_and_data.R
        ↓
02_initial_Dex_response.R
        ↓
03_persistent_kinase_memory.R
        ↓
04_kinase_interference.R
        ↓
05_integrated_kinase_trajectory.R
        ↓
06_make_final_kinase_figure.R

The workflow automatically retrieves the required public input files when the data/ directory is missing.

3 Input data

The analysis uses:

data/log2CPM_matrix.txt
data/studydesign.tsv
data/dex_log2FC.txt
data/dextable.txt
data/KinHubKinaseList.csv

The AP-1 RNA-seq files originate from the public cellular-memory repository:

https://github.com/arjunrajlaboratory/cellularmemory

Relevant source directory:

extractedData/burninrnaseq/202208/

The kinase reference list is obtained from the KinHub/OpenKinome resource.

4 Load analysis outputs

5 Data integrity and sample alignment

The expression dataset contains 191 analyzable samples after alignment with the experimental design.

Sample_147 is present in the design metadata but is absent from the final expression matrix and is therefore excluded during the alignment step.

The setup script verifies that the final metadata order exactly matches the expression-matrix sample order before downstream analysis.

13 Reproducibility

The repository uses renv to record the R package environment.

A fresh clone can be reproduced with:

git clone <repository-url>
cd AP1_cellular_memory_analysis

Restore the package environment:

Rscript -e "renv::restore()"

Then execute the complete workflow:

Rscript run_all.R

The data-fetching script automatically downloads the required external data when they are not already present.

15 Summary

This reproducible workflow:

  1. retrieves the required public datasets;
  2. validates sample alignment;
  3. quantifies the initial dexamethasone kinase response;
  4. identifies persistent kinase-associated memory;
  5. evaluates JNK-IN-8 and T-5224 interference conditions;
  6. integrates kinase trajectories;
  7. generates the final kinase trajectory figure.

The current analysis identifies nine kinase candidates that pass the defined memory-associated kinase FDR criterion.

Their initial-response, memory, and interference profiles are retained in the integrated result table for downstream biological interpretation.
